title: TransactionRequest
description: Request body of the public POST /v1/transactions resource (INV-NOTE-3 §19.2, FR-M.2, INV-REQ-805; INV-T-2856, T12). Also reused, transaction-by-transaction, inside a POST /v1/batches manifest (FR-M.8, INV-REQ-811) and as the base of POST /v1/issuances (FR-AE.2, INV-REQ-324). ingestion-svc forwards this body to canonical-svc's internal recordDocument (sync-edges.yaml ingestion-svc -> canonical-svc), which assigns or binds the Doc UUID; entityRef is checked against the caller's token scope (API-24) rather than carried as a separate tenantId, since tenant and entity scope come from the OAuth token on the public surface. Field names and shapes mirror canonical/openapi.yaml's RecordDocumentRequest/Party/Line/Totals one-for-one so the two sides of the sync edge never drift.

entityRef.description: The registered entity submitting the transaction; checked against the caller's token scope (API-24).

sourceSystem.description: The upstream ERP, POS or expense system this transaction came from.

sourceKey.description: The source system's own key for this transaction (API-13); part of the idempotency pair (API-15, FR-M.3).

sourceRevision.description: The source system's revision marker; part of the idempotency pair (API-15, FR-M.3). A repeat with a lower value than already recorded is ING-002.

documentFunction.description: Closed request enumeration (API-09); a bill for payment also requires documentNumber (ING-009).

documentNumber.description: Required when documentFunction is BILL_FOR_PAYMENT (ING-009); otherwise omitted, never sent null (API-14).

currency.description: The document's currency; money fields below carry this currency unless the data dictionary gives them their own (API-12).

counterparty.description: The transaction's two parties (SDS §19.2 'counterparty'; canonical/openapi.yaml calls the same object 'parties').

unitPrice.description: Money as a decimal string, up to 6 places (API-12).

lineAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).

taxAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).
